terra.problem: Saying the answer “points the wrong way” uses “wrong” about the baker’s answer.
The explanation repeats the answer and verse without adding insight or a distinctive Papa Dorin voice.
“We’ve all got a few” assumes the baker has doubts, though the baker has not said so.
Calling love for one another “a small act” reduces what the passage says to a single act and presents God remaining in us as its result.
The joke’s comparison does not click: a résumé can be held just as a gift can, so the claimed difference is unclear.
“Not dread, not nerves” suggests the passage promises an absence of nerves. It says love is perfected so that we may have confidence.
“Nothing swaps places with it” asserts that nothing replaces fear. The verse says perfect love drives fear out but does not address what might take its place.
“One doesn’t go without the other” suggests the relationship works in both directions. The verse says that someone who does not love his brother cannot love God.
The facts about Solomon are outside this passage and need a Bible reference.
